name: hortis
description: Hortis – Zimmerpflanzen, Bonsai und Selbstversorgung in einer self-hosted App

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @hortis/api & npm run dev -w @hortis/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hortis/shared && npm run build -w @hortis/care-engine && npm run build -w @hortis/garden-engine && npm run build -w @hortis/bonsai-engine && npm run build -w @hortis/api && npm run build -w @hortis/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @hortis/care-engine && npm run test -w @hortis/garden-engine
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w @hortis/web && npm run sync -w @hortis/mobile
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npm run open:android -w @hortis/mobile
